verses.text: Ix ek' jun pekti', a heb' moabita yet' heb' amonita, junnhej ix yutej sb'a heb' yet' heb' meunita yik syak'an owal heb' yet' Judá.

Yuj chi' ix jawi jaywanh winak yal t'a winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá icha tik: Ha t'a Edom yet' t'a junxo sk'axepal ha' mar Muerto, wan skot jantak soldado t'ayach. Ayxoek' heb' t'a chonhab' Hazezon-tamar, xchi heb' winh. (Ha jun chonhab' chi' skuchan pax En-gadi.)
Ix te xiw winhaj Josafat chi', ix snaan winh to syak'och sb'a winh t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, yuj chi' ix yal winh to masanil anima t'a yol yik Judá tz'och t'a tzek'ojk'olal.
Ix kot masanil anima t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá chi' yik sk'anan skolwal Jehová heb' yet' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e linhan winhaj Josafat chi' t'a skal masanil heb' anima molanek' t'a Jerusalén chi', t'a yichanh jun ak' yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ach Jehová, ko Diosal ach yet' heb' ko mam kicham, a ach tik sDiosal ach satcha'anh, Yajal ach pax t'a yib'anh masanil chonhab'. Te niwan a poder, malaj junok mach syal stek'b'an sb'a t'a ichanh.

Ach ko Diosal, a ach ik'nakel juntzanh anima kajan t'a sat lu'um tik, haton b'aj ayonh ek' a onh a chonhab' Israel onh tik. Ak'annakkan lum t'a junelnhej t'ayonh a onh yinhtil onh kan winhaj Abraham tik, haton winh a wach'k'ool.
Ayik kajnajnakxo heb' ko mam kicham t'a tik, sb'oannakk'e jun templo heb' to ik yaji, yalannak heb' icha tik:

Tato sjawi junok yaelal t'a kib'anh ma junok owal sjawi yuj ko chukal, ma ilya, ma wejel, ol onh jawok t'a ichanh t'a a templo tik, yujto ayach ek' t'ay. Ha t'a skal ko yaelal chi' ol ko k'an a kolwal, ol ab'an tas ol ko k'ana', ol onh a kolani, xchi heb'.

Ha tiknaik jun, ina yajek' heb' amonita, heb' moabita yet' heb' kajan t'a tzalkixtak yik Seir, haton lum sluum heb' b'aj maj yal a k'ol ek'nakkot heb' ko mam kicham a onh israel onh tik ayik yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto, to sk'exb'eejnak sb'a heb', maj satjiel-laj heb' anima chi' yuj heb'.
Axo tiknaik jun, a tas tz'aj spakan jun chi' heb' t'ayonh, to snib'ej heb' syak' owal ket'ok yik tzonh yik'el heb' t'a lum lum ak'nak ko makb'enej tik.

Ach ko Diosal, elok wal t'a a k'ool to tzak'och syaelal heb', yujto a onh tik malaj kip yik sko tek'b'an ko b'a t'a yichanh jantak heb' soldado wan sjawi yak' owal t'a tik. Manh kojtakok tas wal sko k'ulej, yuj chi' a t'ayach skak'och ko pensar, xchi winh rey chi' t'a Jehová.
Masanil heb' aj Judá, linhank'e heb' t'a yichanh Jehová yet' masanil yetb'eyum yet' yal yuninal heb', wach'chom heb' te kotakto.
Ay jun winh lewita yinhtilal winhaj Asaf skuchan Jahaziel yuninal winhaj Zacarías, yixchikin winhaj Benaías yuninal winhaj Jeiel, yixchikin winhaj Matanías. Ix och Yespíritu Jehová t'a winh,

yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Ab'ek wal ex aj Judá, ex aj Jerusalén yet' ach rey Josafat. Xchi wal Jehová icha tik: Manh ex xiwok, manh eyek xiw he b'a t'a yichanh jantak soldado chi', yujto a jun owal chi', manh eyikok, palta wik a in Dios in tik.
Ha k'ik'an tzex emk'och eyak' owal yet' heb'. Sk'eul heb' t'a lum switzal yik Sis, yik tze chalan he b'a yet' heb' t'a stitak ha ha' tzek' t'a tzinan lum yik Jeruel.

Manhok ex ol eyak' owal chi', palta tonhej ol ex aj ta', malaj tas ol he k'ulej, tonhej ol eyila' tas ol aj ex in kolani, xchi Jehová. Yuj chi' he masanil ex kajan ex t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a Judá, manh ex xiwok, manh eyek xiw he b'a. Tzex b'at k'ik'an chi', yujto a Jehová ayoch ket'ok, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix em kumnaj winhaj Josafat chi', ix emk'och snanhal sat winh t'a sat lu'um, ix empax kumnaj masanil heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Jerusalén chi', ix yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ay juntzanh heb' lewita yinhtilal winhaj Koat yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Coré, ix syamanoch heb' sb'itan t'a chaanh, syalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová sDiosal Israel.

Axo t'a q'uinhib'alil t'a junxo k'u chi', ak'walto ix k'e wan heb' smasanil, ix b'at heb' t'a sb'eal tzinan lu'um yik Tecoa. Ayik wan sb'at heb' chi', ix och tek'tek' winhaj Josafat, ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Ab'ek tas ol wal ex aj Jerusalén yet' ex aj Judá: Kak'ekoch Jehová ko Diosal yipok ko k'ool, malaj tas ol onh ik'anok, skak'anpaxoch heb' schekab' Dios tik yipok ko k'ool yik wach'nhej ol aj kelk'ochi, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ayik toxo ix lajwi slolon winh yet' heb' chonhab' chi', ix sik'anel juntzanh heb' sb'itan winh. Ix yak'anoch spichul heb' yik yopisio yik b'it. Ix b'ab'laj heb' yuj heb' soldado. Syalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová t'a b'ital icha tik: Kaq'ek yuj diosal t'a Jehová, yujto tzonh xajanej t'a masanil tiempo, xchi heb'.

Ayik ix schaanel yich heb' sb'itan wach' lolonel chi' t'a tzalajk'olal chi', haxo Jehová ix ak'anoch somk'olal t'a skal heb' wan skot yak' owal yet' heb' aj Judá chi', haton heb' amonita, heb' moabita yet' heb' ix kot t'a tzalkixtak yik Seir chi'. Yuj chi' ix ak'ji ganar heb'.
Yujto a heb' amonita yet' heb' moabita chi', ix och heb' yak' owal yet' heb' ix kot t'a Seir chi', ix lajwiel heb' smasanil yuj heb'. Ixlajwi chi', axonhej heb' ix yutej sb'a, ix satlanel sb'a heb'.
Axo yik ix k'och heb' winh winak yik Judá b'aj chekel lum tzinan lu'um, ix yilanb'at heb' winh to a heb' ajk'ol chi' latz'anem heb' t'a sat lum schami, manhxa junok heb' ixto elkani.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Josafat yet' heb' soldado ajun yet'ok chi', yik sb'at sik'anchaanh heb' masanil tas ix kan yuj heb' ajk'ol ix cham chi'. Ix ilchaj yamk'ab' yuj heb', pichul yet' juntzanhxo tas te karo stojol. Yuj chi' tzijtum tas ix yik' heb', palta ayto tas majxo tzak'wan heb' yik'ankoti. Ha jantak tas ix yik'kot heb' chi', oxe' k'ual ix yak' heb' smolank'ei.

Axo t'a schanhil k'ual, ix smolb'an sb'a heb' t'a jun ak'lik skuchan Beraca. Ata' ix yal wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová. Yuj chi' spanhanil Beraca ix sb'iejkan jun lugar chi' yuj heb'. (Beraca syalelk'ochi aloj wach' lolonel.)
Ixlajwi chi', t'a tzalajk'olal ix b'ab'laj winhaj Josafat yuj heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Jerusalén, yujto a Jehová ix ak'an jun tzalajk'olal chi' t'a heb' yujto ix ak'ji ganar heb' ajk'ol chi'.
Axo ix jawi heb' t'a Jerusalén, ix b'at heb' t'a stemplo Jehová yet' sonal salterio, te' kítara yet' k'een trompeta.
Ayik ix ab'chaji to a Jehová ix ak'an owal yet' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a heb' israel chi', ix te xiw masanil juntzanhxo nakión t'a Dios chi'.
Junk'olal ix yak' reyal winhaj Josafat chi', yujto ha Dios ix ak'an junk'olal t'a skal winh yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a slak'anil chi'.
Ayik 35 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Josafat chi' ix schaanel yich winh yak'an reyal t'a Judá, 25 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a chonhab' Jerusalén. Azuba sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Silhi.
Ha winhaj Josafat chi', wach'nhej ix yutej sb'a winh icha ix yutej sb'a winhaj Asa smam winh. Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winh, tojolnhej t'a yichanh Jehová.
Palta a juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal b'ajtak chaanh, maj yik'el-laj winh, yujto manh masanilok heb' anima tek'anxo spensar yoch tzak'an yuj sDiosal heb' yet' smam yicham.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Josafat chi' ayik ix el yich, masanto ix lajwi, tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a yumal yik winhaj Jehú yuninal winhaj Hanani, junnhej yajkan yet' yumal yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Axo t'a slajwub'al sreyal winhaj Josafat chi', ix sb'oan strato winh yet' winhaj Ocozías sreyal Israel. Ha jun winh rey chi', te chuk spensar winh.
Ix sb'o juntzanh te' barko heb' winh yik sb'at t'a chonhab' Tarsis. Ha t'a chonhab' Ezión-geber ix sb'o te' heb' winh.

Yuj chi', a winhaj Eliezer aj Maresa yuninal winhaj Dodava ix alan jun lolonel tik t'a winhaj Josafat chi': Yujto junnhej ix utej a b'a yet' winhaj Ocozías, yuj chi' a Jehová chok' ol utanb'at masanil tas ix a b'o tik, xchi winh. Yuj chi', chok' ix aj juntzanh te' barko ix sb'o heb' winh chi', majxo yal-laj sb'at te' t'a Tarsis chi'.
